name: Piburger See
kurzbeschreibung: The charming Piburger See is a warm bathing lake with a beach and sunbathing lawns, surrounded by the mountains of the Ötztal.
preis: Kostenlos (Badeanstalt Eintritt ca. 6 €, Parkplatz ca. 5 € pro Tag)
beschreibung:
Overview

Lake Piburger See rests as a shimmering emerald natural jewel at an elevation of 913 meters upon a forested subalpine terrace overlooking the town of Oetz in the lower Ötztal valley. Cradled within a protected nature reserve spanning over 14 hectares, this pristine body of water was formed during a colossal post-glacial rockslide that dammed the ancient valley drainage. Despite its rugged alpine surroundings, Piburger See ranks among the warmest bathing lakes in Tyrol: during sheltered, sun-drenched summer weeks, water surface temperatures climb up to a balmy 24 °C. Encircled by dense evergreen forests, moss-draped granite boulders, and the dramatic backdrop of the jagged Acherkogel peak (3,008 m), the lake provides a serene sanctuary of woodland tranquility and dramatic alpine vistas. Protected as a natural monument since 1929, its shoreline remains remarkably unspoiled.

Route & Requirements

The trail network around Piburger See offers delightful routes suited for every fitness level. The undisputed favorite is the shoreline circuit: extending roughly 3.5 kilometers, this well-maintained forest trail meanders along tranquil reed beds and rocky coves with minimal elevation changes (walking time approx. 1 hour, easy grade T1). A worthwhile scenic spur ascends to the "Seejöchl" vantage rock, delivering an extraordinary bird's-eye view over the entire expanse of the lake. Active hikers often depart from Oetz village center, crossing the historic Wellerbrücke bridge over the churning rapids of the Ötztaler Ache river and ascending through shaded pine woodland to the hamlet of Piburg (150 vertical meters, 45 minutes, grade T2). On the southern shore, a charming public lido features wooden sun decks, manicured sunbathing lawns, and rowboat rentals. To preserve water quality and sensitive bird breeding zones, swimming is restricted to designated lido areas, while private inflatable craft and SUP boards are prohibited. Dogs on leashes are permitted on all forest walking tracks, though excluded from the swimming facility.

Visit & Arrival

Rail passengers travel via ÖBB mainline services to Ötztal Bahnhof terminal, connecting seamlessly to frequent regional VVT bus line 320 heading to Oetz (Gemeindeamt stop). From May to October, a dedicated local hiking shuttle connects Oetz to the hamlet of Piburg. Drivers follow the Inntal autobahn A12 to exit Ötztal and travel federal highway B186 into Oetz, where a winding provincial road ascends directly to Piburg. Pay parking areas are located at the entrance to Piburg village and in Oetzerau, followed by a gentle 10-minute stroll through the woods to the lakeside.

Tips

Rent a traditional wooden rowboat at the lakeside pier early in the morning: gliding across mirror-like water while the jagged granite precipices of the Acherkogel reflect upon the surface is unforgettable. Afterwards, dine on the lakeside terrace of Gasthof Piburger See to savor pan-fried alpine brook trout seasoned with fresh garden herbs.
